bin_aggregation: First actual rawO, max actualH, min actualL, last actual rawC; sum actualVa. Empty bins stay absent. No synthetic/carry OHLC.
current_boundary: Row minute+1<=Entry minute; closed5m bin_end<=Entry. Raw future OHLC/Va discarded before projection.
current_range_denominator: First actual rawO from9:00 through Entry-closed prefix; no prefix actual trade -> UNKNOWN.
daily_range: 100*(rawDailyH-rawDailyL)/rawDailyO; valid finite O,H,L>0,H>=L; within-session ratios, no cross-session split-sensitive price returns.

daily_support.frequency_denominator: valid daily ranges among exact prior20

interactions.I1: Frozen P1 score/positive threshold * M2; P1 is not probability
interactions.I3: Authoritative fresh Path context_direction(-1,0,+1) * M2; otherwise UNKNOWN. No state-to-band mapping.

liquidity_inputs: Prior dailyVa, active5m ratio, actual minute bitmap/count, max no-trade duration(reset across lunch). Last2 are audits, no added model columns.
lookback: Use exact last20 dates in pinned v1 trading-session calendar; prior5 is last5 of that calendar. Missing/unopened dates are not replaced by older sessions.
missing: Explicit None + missing indicators; categorical UNKNOWN; no proxy feature invention.

movement_numeric.M13: current range% on completed actual minute bars
movement_numeric.M14: current realized5m volatility% on completed5m bins
movement_numeric.M15: current range% / prior20 median same-clock range%
movement_numeric.M16: current actual Va pace / prior20 median same-clock Va pace
movement_numeric.M8: median of prior5 session median absolute5m return%
movement_numeric.M9: median of prior20 session median absolute5m return%

pace: Sum actual minuteVa / elapsed regular minutes since9:00, lunch excluded. Complete no-trade prefix has Va0; current daily Va never used.
range30: Rolling clock30min windows step5 within each continuous block; actual prints only, range/first actual rawO. At least1 actual bin; session maximum.
regular_windows: 65 bins:9:00-11:30 and12:30-15:25. Closing auction excluded from Movement/coverage.
return5: C_b/C_a-1 only adjacent actual5m bins in the same uninterrupted morning/afternoon schedule; do not bridge missing bins or lunch.

sameclock_support.denominator: Median strictly prior same-clock range%/pace; <=0 denominator -> UNKNOWN, no cap/fallback
